{{Quote|These primitives must not be allowed to thrive unchecked.|Darth Maul|audio=These_primitives.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A series of hidden '''farms''' belonging to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was located north of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Rellias]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Farm/Legends|farms]] were operated by worker [[glurrg]]s and guarded by [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]] cavalry. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo|invaded]] Naboo, and the farms were uncovered by the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who [[Death/Legends|massacred]] the Gungans and glurrgs there and destroyed the farms.

==Description==
{{Quote|What is this? A hidden farming facility?|Darth Maul|audio=What_is_this.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Ganne_compound.png|thumb|right|275px|The farms were located near a Gungan military compound (pictured).]]
A set of [[Farm/Legends|farms]] used by the indigenous [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was located in the [[Gungan Swamp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The farms were located north of the<ref name="GB" /> [[Water/Legends|underwater]]<ref name="End Game">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref> [[City/Legends|city]] [[Rellias]], which was led by the Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Ganne]]. The farms were built on [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] terrain surrounded by [[Tree/Legends|trees]], with an obscured path leading towards them from the south. A hidden path through the trees on the eastern side of the farms led to a military [[Ganne's compound|compound]] used by Ganne.<ref name="GB" />

Five [[prefab shelter]]s affiliated with Ganne's forces were located within the southern entrance to the farms, which themselves were located further up the path and on its eastern side. The farmland was arranged around two [[Food processing center]]s, where the worker [[glurrg]]s would store [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] gathered from the farms. The processing centers were within the range of two [[Power core/Legends|power cores]], structures that improved the technological efficiency of the buildings.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Excellent. We have destroyed their farming capability. I regret we don't have time to watch them starve. Our mission still requires us to press on.|audio=Destroyed_Farms.flac|Darth Maul|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Maul_farms.png|thumb|left|225px|Maul approaches the Gungan defenders of the farms.]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the farms were tended to by eight Glurrgs and were guarded by six [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]]-riding [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagung]] cavalry and three [[Armor/Legends|armored]] kaadu. Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], and the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|attacked]] the Gungans under the direction of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="GB" /> The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] came across the Gungan farms<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> while searching for Boss Ganne, whom he intended to force to reveal the location of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], the Gungan [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Maul determined that he could not tolerate the Gungans' farming operations.<ref name="GB" /> He [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Gungans and glurrgs and destroyed the farms while the portion of the Droid Army accompanying him continued on to Ganne's compound.<ref name="Prima" /> Maul expressed satisfaction after destroying the farms and wished that he could witness the impact of the loss on the Gungans' food supply.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Trade_Federation_campaign.png|thumb|right|300px|The Gungan farms appeared in the fifth level of the Trade Federation campaign (menu pictured) in ''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds''.]]
The hidden Gungan farms were first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The farms appear in the fifth level of the Trade Federation campaign, "The Search for an Underwater Kingdom." Destroying the farms is optional for the player, and doing so provides them with three additional [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] for their army.<ref name="GB" /> The strategy guide recommends that the player use Maul to attack the Gungans there, confirming the destruction of the farms as [[canon]]ical within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Prima" />

The number of Gungans defending the farms changes depending on the difficulty level selected. In easy mode, four kaadu cavalry are present, while in moderate difficulty, an additional two armored kaadu cavalry are also present. In hard difficulty, which this article follows, there are six kaadu cavalry and three armored cavalry.<ref name="GB" />

The [[2012]] short story "[[End Game]]," written by [[James Luceno]], presents a contradictory account of the Trade Federation's capture of Boss Ganne that does not include the attack on the Gungan farms.<ref name="End Game" /> This article follows events as depicted in ''Galactic Battlegrounds''.
